gold_note: Ankylosaur cladogram. The numbered circles 1-4 are keys, not printed names, so no internal labels are encoded. One three-way node: Saichania, Pinacosaurus and Tarchia, stem entering at Pinacosaurus' height. Several stems enter their nodes away from the middle (node 3's stem enters the Gobisaurus line; nodes 1-3 sit on one vertical); each is read by where the horizontal lines meet. 12 tips, 1 polytomies (3 children). Sample 4 case (census 2, seed 20261201). Topology transcribed from the figure image and checked node by node; topology only.
